hook.en: Every day you touch, breathe and eat millions of germs, yet you rarely fall sick. When you got your measles vaccine as a baby, your body learned to fight a disease it had never met. That is your immune system at work.
hook.bm: Setiap hari anda menyentuh, menghidu dan memakan berjuta-juta kuman, namun jarang jatuh sakit. Apabila anda menerima vaksin campak semasa bayi, badan belajar melawan penyakit yang tidak pernah ditemuinya. Itulah sistem imun anda bekerja.

bigIdeas.en: The body has three lines of defence: barriers, non-specific responses, and specific immunity.
bigIdeas.bm: Badan mempunyai tiga barisan pertahanan: penghalang, gerak balas tidak spesifik, dan keimunan spesifik.

bigIdeas.en: Lymphocytes make antibodies that match specific antigens.
bigIdeas.bm: Limfosit menghasilkan antibodi yang sepadan dengan antigen tertentu.

bigIdeas.en: Immunity can be active or passive, natural or artificial.
bigIdeas.bm: Keimunan boleh aktif atau pasif, semula jadi atau buatan.

bigIdeas.en: AIDS, allergies and autoimmune diseases happen when the immune system fails or overreacts.
bigIdeas.bm: AIDS, alahan dan penyakit autoimun berlaku apabila sistem imun gagal atau bertindak berlebihan.

detail.en: skin, mucus, cilia, stomach acid, tears (lysozyme)
detail.bm: kulit, mukus, silia, asid perut, air mata (lisozim)

definition.en: Foreign molecule that triggers antibody production.
definition.bm: Molekul asing yang mencetuskan penghasilan antibodi.

definition.en: Y-shaped protein made by lymphocytes that binds a specific antigen.
definition.bm: Protein berbentuk Y yang dihasilkan limfosit dan terikat pada antigen tertentu.

definition.en: Engulfing and digesting pathogens by phagocytes (neutrophils, monocytes).
definition.bm: Penelanan dan pencernaan patogen oleh fagosit (neutrofil, monosit).

definition.en: Weakened or dead pathogen (or part of it) that triggers immunity without disease.
definition.bm: Patogen yang dilemahkan atau mati (atau sebahagiannya) yang mencetuskan keimunan tanpa penyakit.

definition.en: Lymphocyte that remembers an antigen for a faster response next time.
definition.bm: Limfosit yang mengingati antigen untuk gerak balas lebih cepat pada masa akan datang.

question.en: Explain why a second dose (booster) of a vaccine gives better protection.
question.bm: Terangkan mengapa dos kedua (penggalak) vaksin memberi perlindungan lebih baik.

steps.en: First dose: lymphocytes respond slowly; antibody level rises a little, then falls (primary response).
steps.bm: Dos pertama: limfosit bergerak balas perlahan; aras antibodi naik sedikit, kemudian turun (gerak balas primer).

steps.en: Memory cells are formed and remain in the body.
steps.bm: Sel ingatan terbentuk dan kekal dalam badan.

steps.en: Booster: memory cells respond quickly, making many more antibodies that stay above the immunity level longer (secondary response).
steps.bm: Penggalak: sel ingatan bergerak balas pantas, menghasilkan lebih banyak antibodi yang kekal melebihi aras keimunan lebih lama (gerak balas sekunder).

answer.en: Memory cells give a faster, stronger, longer-lasting antibody response.
answer.bm: Sel ingatan memberi gerak balas antibodi yang lebih cepat, kuat dan tahan lama.

prompt.en: Select ALL parts of the FIRST line of defence.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA bahagian barisan pertahanan PERTAMA.

options.en: Mucus and cilia in the airways
options.bm: Mukus dan silia dalam saluran udara

explanation.en: Antibodies belong to the third (specific) line of defence.

prompt.en: Which white blood cells engulf and digest bacteria?
prompt.bm: Sel darah putih manakah menelan dan mencerna bakteria?

explanation.en: Phagocytosis is part of the second, non-specific line of defence.
explanation.bm: Fagositosis ialah sebahagian barisan kedua yang tidak spesifik.

prompt.en: Put the steps of phagocytosis in order.

items.en: Bacterium is engulfed into a phagosome

explanation.en: Harmless products are absorbed or released from the cell.
explanation.bm: Hasil yang tidak berbahaya diserap atau dibebaskan dari sel.

prompt.en: Antibodies that make bacteria clump together act by…
prompt.bm: Antibodi yang menyebabkan bakteria bergumpal bertindak melalui…

explanation.en: Clumped bacteria are easier for phagocytes to engulf.
explanation.bm: Bakteria yang bergumpal lebih mudah ditelan fagosit.

prompt.en: Match each antibody action to what it does.
prompt.bm: Padankan setiap tindakan antibodi dengan fungsinya.

explanation.en: Antibodies are specific — each fits one antigen shape.
explanation.bm: Antibodi adalah spesifik — setiap satu sepadan dengan satu bentuk antigen.

prompt.en: Match each example to the type of immunity.
prompt.bm: Padankan setiap contoh dengan jenis keimunan.

left.en: Baby receiving antibodies in breast milk
left.bm: Bayi menerima antibodi melalui susu ibu

left.en: Anti-venom injection after a snake bite

explanation.en: Active = body makes its own antibodies (long-lasting). Passive = antibodies given (short-term).
explanation.bm: Aktif = badan menghasilkan antibodi sendiri (tahan lama). Pasif = antibodi diberikan (jangka pendek).

prompt.en: Why is anti-venom used for snake bites instead of a vaccine?
prompt.bm: Mengapa antibisa digunakan untuk patukan ular dan bukan vaksin?

options.en: Ready-made antibodies act immediately; a vaccine takes days to work
options.bm: Antibodi sedia ada bertindak serta-merta; vaksin mengambil masa beberapa hari

explanation.en: Passive immunity is fast but short-lived because no memory cells are made.
explanation.bm: Keimunan pasif cepat tetapi singkat kerana tiada sel ingatan dihasilkan.

explanation.en: Without T-helper cells the immune system can't coordinate, so infections become deadly.
explanation.bm: Tanpa sel T-pembantu, sistem imun tidak dapat diselaraskan, jadi jangkitan menjadi maut.

options.en: an overreaction of the immune system to a harmless substance
options.bm: tindak balas berlebihan sistem imun terhadap bahan yang tidak berbahaya

options.en: a lack of white blood cells
the immune system attacking its own cells

explanation.en: Allergens like dust mites, pollen or peanuts trigger histamine release. Attacking its own cells is autoimmunity (e.g. lupus).
explanation.bm: Alergen seperti hama habuk, debunga atau kacang mencetuskan pembebasan histamina. Menyerang sel sendiri ialah autoimun (cth. lupus).

prompt.en: The Y-shaped proteins made by lymphocytes are called ______.
prompt.bm: Protein berbentuk Y yang dihasilkan limfosit dipanggil ______.

explanation.en: Each antibody has binding sites that fit one specific antigen.
explanation.bm: Setiap antibodi mempunyai tapak pengikatan yang sepadan dengan satu antigen tertentu.
